system.description: Starting at 14th Level, your Flow, Aegis state solidifies and hardens like steel as you become a Bastion. By spending 2 Focus as part of manifesting your Aegis, you become a Bastion. While a Bastion, you gain the benefits of Aegis and yourself and allied creatures within 20 feet of you gain immunity to the Bruised, Dazed and Chilled conditions. But while a Bastion, your AC reduction is no longer limited to once per turn and its Maximum value increases to (-3).

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
